    FAQ

    What is a Link Building service?

    This is the process of gathering inbound links from high authority websites and securing them to make it visible to users and search engines.

    How are do-follow links different from no-follow links?

    By default, all links are do-follow links that allow search engines to pass on equity credit to your business website. While do-follow links are identified by search engine crawlers, no-follow links are ignored. Furthermore, no-follow links have no power to affect a website’s rankings.

    How does link building impact search engine rankings?

    While link building increases brand awareness and business visibility, it is also a method to indicate that other websites are advocating for your website. This will impact the customers who visit your website and subsequently, your search engine rankings.

    How many links does my website need?

    A comprehensive estimate as to how many links require to be built for your website can be provided only after conducting a thorough audit. In the game of quality and quantity, quality always wins. It is better to have only one white hat backlink rather than several unnatural ones.
